technical.summary: Strong trend structure with extreme overbought conditions and no fresh entry signals; elevated pullback risk despite bullish technicals.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and no lobbying activity; earnings in 43 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior Republicans combined with market fear (35 VIX-like score) present modest contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and small transaction sizes limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (455.8), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational revenues, and earnings in 43 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend structure with three white soldiers pattern and new 20-day high provides technical confirmation, supported by contrarian fear-zone opportunity and weak congressional buy signals.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across all momentum oscillators (RSI, Stochastic, Williams %R, UO) combined with severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), no fresh entry signals, and high earnings risk in 43 days create elevated pullback risk with poor risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure is strong with ADX confirmation and three white soldiers, but entry quality is compromised by extreme overbought conditions across all momentum oscillators with no fresh crossover signals, creating poor risk/reward at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 455.8, flat yield curve, rising DXY) combined with earnings event risk in 43 days and overbought momentum setup create high probability of sharp pullback that would violate swing trade risk parameters.
